decisions.reason: Russian gives metres by default (a cubit 45 cm, four fingers a handbreadth of 7.5 cm, as the Pentateuch note sets), with the Hebrew units as the alternative, as 1 Kings 7:15 and 2 Kings 25:17 in this translation; this differs from the English, which gives feet and inches. Literal keeps the Hebrew units.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:17 and 1 Kings 7:15
decisions.reason: The height keeps the wording of 2 Kings 25:17 and the line around the pillar that of 1 Kings 7:15 in this translation; the thickness and "hollow" are drafted here, since neither parallel has them (m1).

source.text: וְכֹתֶ֨רֶת עָלָ֜יו נְחֹ֗שֶׁת וְקוֹמַ֨ת הַכֹּתֶ֥רֶת הָאַחַת֮ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּוֹת֒ וּשְׂבָכָ֨ה וְרִמּוֹנִ֧ים עַֽל־הַכּוֹתֶ֛רֶת סָבִ֖יב הַכֹּ֣ל נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְכָאֵ֛לֶּה לַֽעַמּ֥וּד הַשֵּׁנִ֖י וְרִמּוֹנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And a capital on it [of] bronze, and [the] height of the capital the one five cubits, and a network and pomegranates on the capital all around, the whole [of] bronze; and like these [was] to the pillar the second, and pomegranates.

en.L: And on it [was] a capital of bronze; and the height of the one capital [was] five cubits, and a network and pomegranates [were] on the capital all around, all of bronze; and the second pillar [had] the like, and pomegranates.
en.B: On top of it was a bronze capital. The capital was {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|five cubits}} high, with a network and pomegranates all around it, all of bronze. The second pillar, with its pomegranates, was the same.
en.R: It had a bronze top, called a capital, that was {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|five cubits}} tall. All around the capital was a net of lattice work with pomegranates on it, all made of bronze. The second pillar, with its pomegranates, was just the same.

es.L: Y sobre ella [había] un capitel de bronce; y la altura de un capitel [era] de cinco codos, y una red y granadas [había] sobre el capitel alrededor, todo de bronce; y semejante [tenía] la segunda columna, y granadas.
es.B: Encima tenía un capitel de bronce. El capitel medía {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de alto, con una red y granadas alrededor, todo de bronce. La segunda columna, con sus granadas, era igual.
es.R: Tenía encima una pieza de bronce, llamada capitel, que medía {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} de alto. Alrededor del capitel había una red de bronce con granadas, todo hecho de bronce. La segunda columna, con sus granadas, era igual.

fr.L: Et sur elle [il y avait] un chapiteau de bronze ; et la hauteur d’un chapiteau [était] de cinq coudées, et un treillis et des grenades [étaient] sur le chapiteau tout autour, le tout de bronze ; et la seconde colonne [avait] la même chose, et des grenades.
fr.B: Elle portait un chapiteau de bronze. Le chapiteau avait {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de haut, avec un treillis et des grenades tout autour, le tout en bronze. La seconde colonne, avec ses grenades, était semblable.
fr.R: Elle avait au sommet une pièce de bronze, appelée chapiteau, haute de {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}}. Tout autour du chapiteau, il y avait un filet en treillis décoré de grenades, le tout en bronze. La seconde colonne, avec ses grenades, était exactement pareille.

sw.L: Na juu yake [kulikuwa na] kichwa cha shaba; na urefu wa kichwa kimoja [ulikuwa] dhiraa tano, na wavu na makomamanga [yalikuwa] juu ya kichwa pande zote, yote ya shaba; na nguzo ya pili [ilikuwa na] mfano wa hayo, na makomamanga.
sw.B: Juu yake kulikuwa na kichwa cha shaba. Kichwa hicho kilikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 2.3|dhiraa tano}}, chenye wavu na makomamanga pande zote, vyote vya shaba. Nguzo ya pili, pamoja na makomamanga yake, ilikuwa vivyo hivyo.
sw.R: Juu yake kulikuwa na kipande cha shaba kilichoitwa kichwa, chenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 2.3|dhiraa tano}}. Kuzunguka kichwa hicho kulikuwa na wavu wa kazi ya kusuka wenye makomamanga, vyote vya shaba. Nguzo ya pili, pamoja na makomamanga yake, ilikuwa sawasawa kabisa.

vi.L: Trên đó [có] một đầu trụ bằng đồng; chiều cao của một đầu trụ [là] năm cu-đê, có lưới và trái lựu chung quanh đầu trụ, tất cả bằng đồng; cây trụ thứ hai cũng [có] như vậy, với trái lựu.
vi.B: Trên đỉnh trụ có đầu trụ bằng đồng. Đầu trụ cao {{units:2,25 m|năm cu-đê}}, chung quanh có lưới và trái lựu, tất cả đều bằng đồng. Cây trụ thứ hai, với các trái lựu của nó, cũng giống như vậy.
vi.R: Trên đỉnh trụ có một phần đầu bằng đồng, gọi là đầu trụ, cao {{units:2,25 m|năm cu-đê}}. Chung quanh đầu trụ có một tấm lưới đan với những trái lựu, tất cả đều bằng đồng. Cây trụ thứ hai, với các trái lựu của nó, cũng giống hệt như vậy.

ko.L: 그리고 그 위에 놋 기둥머리가 [있었다]. 그리고 한 기둥머리의 높이는 오 규빗이었고, 기둥머리 둘레에 그물과 석류들이 [있었는데], 모두 놋이었다. 그리고 둘째 기둥도 이와 같았고, 석류들도 [있었다].
ko.B: 그 위에는 놋 기둥머리가 얹혀 있었다. 그 기둥머리는 {{units:약 2.25미터|오 규빗}} 높이였고, 그 둘레에 그물과 석류들이 있었는데, 모두 놋이었다. 둘째 기둥도 석류들까지 이와 같았다.
ko.R: 그 위에는 기둥머리라고 부르는 놋 머리 장식이 있었는데, {{units:약 2.25미터|오 규빗}} 높이였다. 기둥머리 둘레에는 그물 모양 장식과 석류들이 있었고, 모두 놋으로 만들었다. 둘째 기둥도 석류들까지 똑같았다.

pt.L: E sobre ela [havia] um capitel de bronze; e a altura de um capitel [era de] cinco côvados, e uma rede e romãs [estavam] sobre o capitel ao redor, tudo de bronze; e a segunda coluna [tinha] o mesmo, e romãs.
pt.B: Em cima dela havia um capitel de bronze. O capitel tinha {{units:cerca de 2,25 metros|cinco côvados}} de altura, com uma rede e romãs ao redor, tudo de bronze. A segunda coluna, com as suas romãs, era igual.
pt.R: Ela tinha em cima uma peça de bronze, chamada capitel, que tinha {{units:cerca de 2,25 metros|cinco côvados}} de altura. Em volta do capitel havia uma treliça parecida com uma rede, com romãs, tudo feito de bronze. A segunda coluna, com as suas romãs, era igual.

am.L: በላዩም የነሐስ ጉልላት [ነበረ]፤ የአንዱም ጉልላት ቁመት አምስት ክንድ [ነበረ]፤ በጉልላቱም ዙሪያ መርበብና ሮማኖች [ነበሩ]፤ ሁሉም ነሐስ [ነበረ]፤ ሁለተኛውም ምሰሶ እንደዚሁ [ነበረ]፤ ሮማኖችም [ነበሩት]።
am.B: በላዩም የነሐስ ጉልላት ነበረ። የጉልላቱ ቁመት {{units:2.25 ሜትር ያህል|አምስት ክንድ}} ሲሆን በዙሪያውም መርበብና ሮማኖች ነበሩ፤ ሁሉም ከነሐስ የተሠሩ ነበሩ። ሁለተኛውም ምሰሶ ከሮማኖቹ ጋር እንደዚሁ ነበረ።
am.R: በላዩም ጉልላት የሚባል የነሐስ ራስ ነበረው፤ ቁመቱም {{units:2.25 ሜትር ያህል|አምስት ክንድ}} ነበረ። በጉልላቱ ዙሪያ ሁሉ እንደ መረብ የተሠራ ጌጥ ነበረ፤ በላዩም ሮማኖች ነበሩ፤ ሁሉም ከነሐስ የተሠሩ ነበሩ። ሁለተኛውም ምሰሶ ከሮማኖቹ ጋር ልክ እንደዚሁ ነበረ።

hi.L: और उस पर पीतल का एक शीर्ष [था]; और एक शीर्ष की ऊँचाई पाँच हाथ [थी], और शीर्ष पर चारों ओर जाली और अनार [थे], सब पीतल के; और दूसरे खंभे पर भी ऐसा ही [था], और अनार।
hi.B: उसके ऊपर पीतल का एक शीर्ष था। शीर्ष {{units:लगभग 2.25 मीटर|पाँच हाथ}} ऊँचा था, और उसके चारों ओर जाली और अनार थे, सब पीतल के। दूसरा खंभा भी अपने अनारों समेत ऐसा ही था।
hi.R: उसके ऊपर पीतल का एक ऊपरी हिस्सा था, जिसे शीर्ष कहते हैं, और वह {{units:लगभग 2.25 मीटर|पाँच हाथ}} ऊँचा था। शीर्ष के चारों ओर जालीदार काम था जिस पर अनार बने थे, सब पीतल के। दूसरा खंभा भी अपने अनारों समेत ठीक ऐसा ही था।

ru.L: И капитель на ней медная; и высота одной капители [была] пять локтей, и сетка и гранаты на капители вокруг — всё медное; и такое же у второй колонны, и гранаты.
ru.B: На ней была медная капитель. Капитель была высотой {{units:около 2,3 метра|пять локтей}}, и вокруг неё были сетка и гранаты, всё из меди. Вторая колонна с её гранатами была такой же.
ru.R: Наверху у неё было медное навершие, капитель, высотой {{units:около 2,3 метра|пять локтей}}. Вокруг капители была медная сетка с медными гранатами. Вторая колонна с её гранатами была точно такой же.

uk.L: І на ньому [була] бронзова голівка; і висота однієї голівки [була] пʼять ліктів, а сітка і гранатові яблука [були] на голівці довкола, усе з бронзи; і другий стовп [мав] таке саме, і гранатові яблука.
uk.B: На ньому була бронзова голівка. Голівка була {{units:близько 2,3 метра|пʼять ліктів}} заввишки, з сіткою й гранатовими яблуками довкола, усе з бронзи. Другий стовп з його гранатовими яблуками був такий самий.
uk.R: Він мав бронзовий верх, що називається голівкою, {{units:близько 2,3 метра|пʼять ліктів}} заввишки. Довкола голівки була плетена сітка з гранатовими яблуками на ній, усе з бронзи. Другий стовп з його гранатовими яблуками був точно такий самий.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:17: three cubits there, five here
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 25:17 gives the capital a height of three cubits; Jeremiah gives five, as 1 Kings 7:16 and 2 Chronicles 3:15 do. Kings may have a copying error, or may measure only part of the capital. Kings also ends "with the network", where Jeremiah ends "and pomegranates".

decisions.choice: network and pomegranates: a lattice with bronze fruit
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 7:17-20, the network is a lattice of crossing bands around the capital, and the pomegranates are bronze ornaments in rows on it.

decisions.choice: like these to the second pillar: the second was the same
decisions.reason: Everything said of the first pillar holds for the second; "and pomegranates" names the part described most fully in the next verse.

decisions.choice: a bronze top, called a capital (Readable); modern measure (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:17, Readable explains "capital"; five cubits are about 7 1/2 feet, as in 1 Kings 7:16.

decisions.choice: cinco codos
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's Hebrew gives the capital five cubits, as 1 Kings 7:16, where 2 Kings 25:17 has three.

decisions.choice: "dhiraa tano" (five cubits) where 2 Kings 25:17 has three
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse gives a different height for the capital; the Swahili follows it.

decisions.choice: năm cu-đê (five cubits)
decisions.reason: Jeremiah gives the capital five cubits, where 2 Kings 25:17 has three; Vietnamese follows the Hebrew here.

decisions.choice: "오 규빗" for the capital
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's Hebrew gives five cubits where 2 Kings 25:17 gives three; Korean follows each text.

decisions.choice: the second half of 2 Kings 25:17 ("የነሐስ ጉልላት", "መርበብና ሮማኖች", "ሁሉም ነሐስ"), with "አምስት ክንድ" (five cubits) for "ሦስት ክንድ" (three) and "with pomegranates" for "with the network" at the end.
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's Hebrew gives five cubits, as 1 Kings 7:16; the meaning decision notes the difference.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 25:17, with "पाँच हाथ" and "और अनार"
decisions.reason: The verse copies the Hindi of 2 Kings 25:17 at each level. Jeremiah's Hebrew gives the capital five cubits, as 1 Kings 7:16 (2 Kings has three), with the metric value of 1 Kings 7:16, and ends "and pomegranates" where 2 Kings has "with the network".

decisions.choice: пять локтей; и гранаты
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 25:17 has three cubits and "with the network"; here five cubits and "and pomegranates" (m1). The measure in metres follows 1 Kings 7:16 in this translation.

source.text: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ הָֽרִמֹּנִ֔ים תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֖ה ר֑וּחָה כָּל־הָרִמּוֹנִ֥ים מֵאָ֛ה עַל־הַשְּׂבָכָ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And were the pomegranates ninety and six toward [the] wind; all the pomegranates [were a] hundred on the network all around.

en.L: And the pomegranates were ninety-six on the sides; all the pomegranates [were] a hundred on the network all around.
en.B: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; in all there were a hundred pomegranates on the network all around.
en.R: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides. Altogether a hundred pomegranates went around the network.

es.L: Y había noventa y seis granadas hacia los lados; todas las granadas [eran] cien sobre la red alrededor.
es.B: Había noventa y seis granadas en los lados; en total había cien granadas sobre la red, alrededor.
es.R: Había noventa y seis granadas en los lados. En total, cien granadas rodeaban la red.

fr.L: Et les grenades étaient quatre-vingt-seize sur les côtés ; toutes les grenades [étaient] cent sur le treillis tout autour.
fr.B: Il y avait quatre-vingt-seize grenades sur les côtés ; en tout, il y avait cent grenades sur le treillis tout autour.
fr.R: Il y avait quatre-vingt-seize grenades sur les côtés. En tout, cent grenades faisaient le tour du treillis.

sw.L: Na makomamanga yalikuwa tisini na sita pembeni; makomamanga yote [yalikuwa] mia moja juu ya wavu pande zote.
sw.B: Kulikuwa na makomamanga tisini na sita pembeni; kwa jumla kulikuwa na makomamanga mia moja juu ya wavu pande zote.
sw.R: Kulikuwa na makomamanga tisini na sita pembeni. Kwa jumla makomamanga mia moja yalizunguka wavu.

vi.L: Có chín mươi sáu trái lựu ở các mặt bên; tất cả trái lựu trên lưới chung quanh [là] một trăm.
vi.B: Có chín mươi sáu trái lựu ở các mặt bên; tổng cộng có một trăm trái lựu trên tấm lưới chung quanh.
vi.R: Có chín mươi sáu trái lựu ở các mặt bên. Tất cả có một trăm trái lựu bao quanh tấm lưới.

ko.L: 그리고 석류들은 옆면에 아흔여섯 개였고, 그물 둘레의 석류는 모두 백 개였다.
ko.B: 옆면에 석류가 아흔여섯 개 있었고, 그물 둘레에 있는 석류는 모두 백 개였다.
ko.R: 옆면에는 석류가 아흔여섯 개 있었다. 그물을 빙 둘러 있는 석류는 모두 백 개였다.

pt.L: E as romãs eram noventa e seis nos lados; todas as romãs [eram] cem sobre a rede ao redor.
pt.B: Havia noventa e seis romãs nos lados; ao todo eram cem romãs sobre a rede ao redor.
pt.R: Havia noventa e seis romãs nos lados. Ao todo, cem romãs davam a volta na rede.

am.L: በየጎኑም ዘጠና ስድስት ሮማኖች ነበሩ፤ በመርበቡ ዙሪያ የነበሩት ሮማኖች ሁሉ መቶ ነበሩ።
am.B: በጎኖቹ ላይ ዘጠና ስድስት ሮማኖች ነበሩ፤ በመርበቡ ዙሪያ በአጠቃላይ መቶ ሮማኖች ነበሩ።
am.R: በጎኖቹ ላይ ዘጠና ስድስት ሮማኖች ነበሩ። በአጠቃላይ መቶ ሮማኖች በመርበቡ ዙሪያ ነበሩ።

hi.L: और अनार हवा की ओर छियानवे थे; जाली पर चारों ओर सब अनार सौ [थे]।
hi.B: किनारों पर छियानवे अनार थे; जाली पर चारों ओर कुल मिलाकर सौ अनार थे।
hi.R: किनारों पर छियानवे अनार थे। जाली के चारों ओर कुल सौ अनार लगे थे।

ru.L: И было гранатов девяносто шесть по сторонам; всех гранатов [было] сто на сетке вокруг.
ru.B: По сторонам было девяносто шесть гранатов; всего на сетке вокруг было сто гранатов.
ru.R: По сторонам было девяносто шесть гранатов. Всего вокруг сетки шли сто гранатов.

uk.L: І гранатових яблук було девʼяносто шість з боків; усіх гранатових яблук [було] сто на сітці довкола.
uk.B: З боків було девʼяносто шість гранатових яблук; усього на сітці довкола було сто гранатових яблук.
uk.R: З боків було девʼяносто шість гранатових яблук. Усього довкола сітки було сто гранатових яблук.

decisions.choice: on the sides: literally "toward the wind"
decisions.reason: The phrase, used only here, seems to mean the sides facing outward, toward the four winds. Perhaps ninety-six could be seen from the sides and four more were hidden or stood at the corners, making a hundred in each row. The exact sense is not known.

decisions.choice: a hundred in a row: 1 Kings 7:20, 42
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:20 speaks of two hundred pomegranates in rows around each capital, and 1 Kings 7:42 of four hundred for the two networks, two rows on each. That fits a hundred in each row. 2 Kings 25 gives no numbers.

decisions.choice: on the sides
decisions.reason: All levels say "on the sides" for the rare phrase "toward the wind", without settling what it means (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: not in 2 Kings; drafted from the Hebrew with the craft words of 2 Kings 25:17 ("ሮማኖች", "መርበብ").
decisions.reason: 2 Kings has no parallel to this verse.

decisions.choice: "हवा की ओर"
decisions.reason: 2 Kings has no parallel to this verse. Literal keeps the Hebrew "toward the wind", whose sense is uncertain; Balanced and Readable say "on the sides", as the English does at every level.

decisions.choice: по сторонам
decisions.reason: The rare phrase "toward the wind" (m1); every level says "по сторонам", as the English says "on the sides", without settling what it means.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֣ח רַב־טַבָּחִ֗ים אֶת־שְׂרָיָה֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְאֶת־צְפַנְיָ֖ה כֹּהֵ֣ן הַמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וְאֶת־שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַסַּֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: And took [the] chief of [the] guards Seraiah [the] priest of the head, and Zephaniah [the] priest of the second [rank], and [the] three keepers of the threshold.

en.L: And the chief of the guard took Seraiah the head priest and Zephaniah the second priest and the three keepers of the threshold.
en.B: The captain of the guard also seized Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest next to him, and the three doorkeepers.
en.R: The commander of the guard also arrested Seraiah the high priest, Zephaniah the priest next in rank, and the three men who guarded the temple entrance.

es.L: Y el jefe de la guardia tomó a Seraías, el sacerdote principal, y a Sofonías, el segundo sacerdote, y a los tres guardianes del umbral.
es.B: El capitán de la guardia también apresó a Seraías, el sacerdote principal, a Sofonías, el sacerdote que le seguía en rango, y a los tres porteros.
es.R: El comandante de la guardia también arrestó a Seraías, el sumo sacerdote, a Sofonías, el sacerdote que le seguía en rango, y a los tres hombres que cuidaban la entrada del templo.

fr.L: Et le chef des gardes prit Seraya le prêtre en chef, et Sophonie le second prêtre, et les trois gardiens du seuil.
fr.B: Le commandant de la garde prit aussi Seraya, le prêtre en chef, Sophonie, le prêtre en second, et les trois gardiens du seuil.
fr.R: Le chef de la garde a aussi arrêté Seraya, le grand prêtre, Sophonie, le prêtre qui venait après lui, et les trois hommes qui gardaient l’entrée du temple.

sw.L: Naye mkuu wa walinzi akamchukua Seraya kuhani mkuu na Sefania kuhani wa pili, na walinzi watatu wa kizingiti.
sw.B: Kamanda wa walinzi alimkamata pia Seraya kuhani mkuu, Sefania kuhani aliyefuata kwa cheo, na mabawabu watatu.
sw.R: Kamanda wa walinzi alimkamata pia Seraya kuhani mkuu, Sefania kuhani aliyefuata kwa cheo, na watu watatu waliolinda mlango wa hekalu.

vi.L: Quan chỉ huy vệ binh bắt Sê-ra-gia, thầy tế lễ đứng đầu, Sô-phô-ni, thầy tế lễ bậc thứ hai, và ba người giữ ngưỡng cửa.
vi.B: Quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ cũng bắt Sê-ra-gia, thầy tế lễ cả, Sô-phô-ni, thầy tế lễ phó, và ba người giữ cửa.
vi.R: Người chỉ huy đội cận vệ cũng bắt giữ Sê-ra-gia, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, Sô-phô-ni, thầy tế lễ bậc kế tiếp, và ba người canh giữ lối vào đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 경호대장이 으뜸 제사장 스라야와 버금 제사장 스바냐와 세 문지기를 붙잡았다.
ko.B: 경호대장은 또 대제사장 스라야와 그다음 서열의 제사장 스바냐와 세 문지기를 붙잡았다.
ko.R: 경호대장은 또 대제사장 스라야와 그다음 서열의 제사장 스바냐와 성전 입구를 지키던 세 사람을 체포했다.

pt.L: E o chefe da guarda tomou Seraías, o sacerdote-chefe, e Sofonias, o segundo sacerdote, e os três guardas da soleira.
pt.B: O capitão da guarda prendeu também Seraías, o sacerdote-chefe, Sofonias, o sacerdote que vinha logo abaixo dele, e os três porteiros.
pt.R: O comandante da guarda também prendeu Seraías, o sumo sacerdote, Sofonias, o sacerdote seguinte em autoridade, e os três homens que guardavam a entrada do templo.

am.L: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ የካህናቱን አለቃ ሠራያን፣ ሁለተኛውንም ካህን ሶፎንያስን፣ ሦስቱንም የደጃፍ ጠባቂዎች ወሰደ።
am.B: የዘበኞቹ አለቃ የካህናቱን አለቃ ሠራያን፣ ከእርሱ ቀጥሎ ያለውን ካህን ሶፎንያስንና ሦስቱን በር ጠባቂዎች ደግሞ ያዘ።
am.R: የዘበኞቹ አዛዥ ሊቀ ካህናቱን ሠራያን፣ ከእርሱ ቀጥሎ የነበረውን ካህን ሶፎንያስንና የቤተ መቅደሱን መግቢያ የሚጠብቁትን ሦስት ሰዎች ደግሞ አሰራቸው።

hi.L: और अंगरक्षकों के प्रधान ने मुख्य याजक सरायाह को और दूसरे याजक सपन्याह को और डेवढ़ी के तीनों रखवालों को ले लिया।
hi.B: अंगरक्षकों के प्रधान ने मुख्य याजक सरायाह को, उसके नीचे के याजक सपन्याह को और तीनों द्वारपालों को भी पकड़ लिया।
hi.R: अंगरक्षकों के सेनापति ने महायाजक सरायाह को, उससे नीचे के पद के याजक सपन्याह को, और मंदिर के प्रवेश पर पहरा देनेवाले तीनों पुरुषों को भी गिरफ़्तार कर लिया।

ru.L: И взял начальник телохранителей Сераию, главного священника, и Софонию, второго священника, и трёх стражей порога.
ru.B: Начальник стражи взял также первосвященника Сераию, следующего за ним священника Софонию и трёх привратников.
ru.R: Командир стражи также схватил первосвященника Сераию, священника Софонию, второго после него, и трёх человек, охранявших вход в храм.

uk.L: І начальник варти взяв Сераю, головного священника, і Софонію, другого священника, і трьох сторожів порога.
uk.B: Начальник варти схопив також Сераю, первосвященника, Софонію, священника, що був після нього, і трьох сторожів входу.
uk.R: Начальник варти заарештував також Сераю, первосвященника, Софонію, священника, наступного за ним, і трьох чоловіків, які стерегли вхід до храму.

decisions.choice: the same words as 2 Kings 25:18
decisions.reason: The verse is the same as 2 Kings 25:18 apart from a shorter spelling of Zephaniah's name and "the" before "second", and the wording follows it.

decisions.choice: Seraiah the head priest: the high priest
decisions.reason: "The head priest" is the leading priest of the temple (2 Chronicles 19:11). Seraiah was the grandson of Hilkiah, the high priest under Josiah, and an ancestor of Ezra (1 Chronicles 5:39-41; Ezra 7:1). He is not the Seraiah son of Neriah of 51:59.

decisions.choice: Zephaniah the second priest: the high priest's deputy
decisions.reason: The priest "of second rank" was next after the high priest (2 Kings 23:4). Zephaniah son of Maaseiah carried messages between King Zedekiah and Jeremiah (21:1; 29:25-29; 37:3).

decisions.choice: the keepers of the threshold: senior temple officers
decisions.reason: They guarded the entrances of the temple and received the money brought in (2 Kings 12:10; 22:4). Jeremiah 35:4 names one of them, Maaseiah son of Shallum.

decisions.choice: doorkeepers (Balanced); the men who guarded the temple entrance (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:18, Balanced and Readable explain the titles, and Readable says "arrested" for "took".

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 25:18
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 2 Kings 25:18, and each level copies its Hindi. This Seraiah the priest is not Seraiah son of Neriah (51:59), though Hindi writes both names "सरायाह", as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 25:18
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew as 2 Kings 25:18 (m1).

source.text: וּמִן־הָעִ֡יר לָקַח֩ סָרִ֨יס אֶחָ֜ד אֲֽשֶׁר־הָיָ֥ה פָקִ֣יד׀עַל־אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְשִׁבְעָ֨ה אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מֵרֹאֵ֤י פְנֵי־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצְא֣וּ בָעִ֔יר וְאֵ֗ת סֹפֵר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֔א הַמַּצְבִּ֖א אֶת־עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים אִישׁ֙ מֵעַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ הַֽנִּמְצְאִ֖ים בְּת֥וֹךְ הָעִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And from the city he took one official who had been overseer over [the] men of the war, and seven men of [those] seeing [the] face of the king who were found in the city, and [the] scribe of [the] commander of the army, the one mustering the people of the land, and sixty men of [the] people of the land, the ones found in [the] midst of the city.

en.L: And from the city he took one eunuch who had been the overseer over the men of war, and seven men of those who saw the face of the king, who were found in the city, and the scribe of the commander of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the midst of the city.
en.B: From the city he took a court officer who had been in charge of the soldiers, seven of the king's advisers who were found in the city, the secretary of the commander of the army, who mustered the people of the land for war, and sixty of the people of the land who were still in the city.
en.R: From the city he also took the palace official in charge of the soldiers and seven of the king's close advisers who were still in the city. He took the army commander's secretary, who called up the men of the land to serve in the army. He also took sixty of those men who were still in the city.

es.L: Y de la ciudad tomó a un eunuco que era el encargado de los hombres de guerra, y a siete hombres de los que veían el rostro del rey que se hallaron en la ciudad, y al escriba del jefe del ejército, que reclutaba al pueblo de la tierra, y a sesenta hombres del pueblo de la tierra que se hallaron en medio de la ciudad.
es.B: De la ciudad tomó a un funcionario que había estado a cargo de los soldados, a siete de los consejeros del rey que se encontraban en la ciudad, al secretario del jefe del ejército, que reclutaba para la guerra al pueblo de la tierra, y a sesenta hombres del pueblo de la tierra que todavía estaban en la ciudad.
es.R: De la ciudad también tomó al oficial encargado de los soldados y a siete de los consejeros más cercanos del rey que todavía estaban en la ciudad. Tomó al secretario del jefe del ejército, que llamaba a los hombres del país a servir en el ejército. También tomó a sesenta de esos hombres que todavía estaban en la ciudad.

fr.L: Et de la ville il prit un eunuque qui était préposé aux hommes de guerre, et sept hommes de ceux qui voyaient la face du roi, qui se trouvaient dans la ville, et le secrétaire du chef de l’armée, qui recrutait le peuple du pays, et soixante hommes du peuple du pays qui se trouvaient au milieu de la ville.
fr.B: Il prit dans la ville un haut fonctionnaire qui commandait les soldats, sept des conseillers du roi qu’on trouva dans la ville, le secrétaire du chef de l’armée, qui enrôlait le peuple du pays pour la guerre, et soixante hommes du peuple du pays qui se trouvaient encore dans la ville.
fr.R: Dans la ville, il a aussi pris le fonctionnaire du palais qui commandait les soldats, et sept des proches conseillers du roi qui étaient encore là. Il a pris le secrétaire du chef de l’armée, qui appelait les hommes du pays à servir dans l’armée. Il a aussi pris soixante de ces hommes qui étaient encore dans la ville.

sw.L: Na kutoka mjini akamchukua towashi mmoja aliyekuwa msimamizi juu ya watu wa vita, na watu saba wa wale walioona uso wa mfalme, walioonekana mjini, na mwandishi wa jemadari wa jeshi, aliyewaandikisha watu wa nchi, na watu sitini wa watu wa nchi walioonekana katikati ya mji.
sw.B: Kutoka mjini alimchukua afisa mmoja aliyekuwa msimamizi wa askari, washauri saba wa mfalme walioonekana mjini, katibu wa mkuu wa jeshi, aliyewaandikisha watu wa nchi kwenda vitani, na watu sitini wa watu wa nchi waliokuwa bado mjini.
sw.R: Kutoka mjini alimchukua pia afisa aliyesimamia askari na washauri saba wa karibu wa mfalme waliokuwa bado mjini. Alimchukua katibu wa mkuu wa jeshi, aliyewaita watu wa nchi kujiunga na jeshi. Pia aliwachukua watu sitini wa hao waliokuwa bado mjini.

vi.L: Từ trong thành hắn bắt một hoạn quan là người được giao cai quản quân lính, bảy người trong số những người được thấy mặt vua còn ở trong thành, viên thư ký của tướng chỉ huy quân đội, là người tuyển mộ dân trong xứ, và sáu mươi người trong dân của xứ còn ở giữa thành.
vi.B: Từ trong thành hắn bắt một triều thần đã chỉ huy quân lính, bảy cố vấn của vua còn ở trong thành, viên thư ký của tướng chỉ huy quân đội, là người lo tuyển mộ dân trong xứ ra trận, và sáu mươi người dân trong xứ còn ở trong thành.
vi.R: Từ trong thành hắn cũng bắt viên quan chỉ huy quân lính và bảy cố vấn thân cận của vua còn ở trong thành. Hắn bắt viên thư ký của tướng chỉ huy quân đội, là người gọi đàn ông trong xứ nhập ngũ. Hắn cũng bắt sáu mươi người trong số những người ấy còn ở trong thành.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 성에서 군사들을 맡은 내시 하나와, 성 안에서 발견된 왕의 얼굴을 보는 자들 일곱 명과, 그 땅의 백성을 징집하던 군대 사령관의 서기관과, 성 안에서 발견된 그 땅의 백성 60명을 붙잡았다.
ko.B: 그는 또 성 안에서 군사를 맡은 관리 하나와, 성 안에 있던 왕의 측근 일곱 명과, 그 땅의 백성을 군대로 징집하던 군대 사령관의 서기관과, 성 안에 남아 있던 그 땅의 백성 60명을 붙잡았다.
ko.R: 그는 또 성 안에서 군인들을 지휘하던 관리와, 아직 성 안에 남아 있던 왕의 가까운 신하 일곱 명을 잡아갔다. 그는 그 땅의 사람들을 불러 모아 군대에 들어가게 하던 군대 사령관의 서기관도 잡아갔다. 그리고 성 안에 남아 있던 그 땅의 사람 60명도 잡아갔다.

pt.L: E da cidade tomou um eunuco que era encarregado dos homens de guerra, e sete homens dos que viam a face do rei, que se acharam na cidade, e o escrivão do comandante do exército, que alistava o povo da terra, e sessenta homens do povo da terra que se acharam no meio da cidade.
pt.B: Da cidade ele levou também um oficial que tinha sido encarregado dos soldados, sete conselheiros do rei que ainda estavam na cidade, o secretário do comandante do exército, que alistava o povo da terra para a guerra, e sessenta homens do povo da terra que ainda estavam na cidade.
pt.R: Da cidade ele também levou o oficial encarregado dos soldados e sete dos conselheiros mais próximos do rei, que ainda estavam na cidade. Levou o secretário do comandante do exército, que convocava os homens da terra para servir no exército. Também levou sessenta desses homens que ainda estavam na cidade.

am.L: ከከተማዪቱም በጦር ሰዎች ላይ ተሹሞ የነበረውን አንድ ጃንደረባ፣ በከተማዪቱም የተገኙትን የንጉሡን ፊት ከሚያዩት ሰባት ሰዎች፣ የአገሩንም ሕዝብ የሚመለምለውን የሠራዊቱን አለቃ ጸሐፊ፣ በከተማዪቱም መካከል የተገኙትን ከአገሩ ሕዝብ ስድሳ ሰዎች ወሰደ።
am.B: ከከተማዪቱ በወታደሮቹ ላይ ተሹሞ የነበረውን አንድ የቤተ መንግሥት ሹም፣ በከተማዪቱ የተገኙትን ሰባት የንጉሡን አማካሪዎች፣ የአገሩን ሕዝብ ለጦርነት የሚመለምለውን የሠራዊቱን አለቃ ጸሐፊና በከተማዪቱ ገና የነበሩትን ከአገሩ ሕዝብ ስድሳ ሰዎች ወሰደ።
am.R: ከከተማዪቱ ደግሞ በወታደሮቹ ላይ ኃላፊ የነበረውን የቤተ መንግሥት ሹም፣ በከተማዪቱ ገና የነበሩትንም ሰባት የንጉሡን የቅርብ አማካሪዎች ወሰደ። የአገሩን ሰዎች ለሠራዊቱ የሚመለምለውን የሠራዊቱን አዛዥ ጸሐፊ ወሰደ። በከተማዪቱ ገና የነበሩትን ከእነዚያ ሰዎች ስድሳውንም ወሰደ።

hi.L: और नगर में से उसने एक खोजे को लिया जो योद्धाओं पर अधिकारी रहा था, और उन सात पुरुषों को जो राजा का मुँह देखनेवालों में से थे, जो नगर में पाए गए, और सेनापति के लेखक को, जो देश के लोगों की गिनती करता था, और देश के लोगों में से साठ पुरुषों को जो नगर के बीच में पाए गए।
hi.B: नगर में से उसने एक अधिकारी को लिया जो सैनिकों पर नियुक्त रहा था, राजा के सात सलाहकारों को जो नगर में पाए गए, सेनापति के सचिव को, जो देश के लोगों को युद्ध के लिए इकट्ठा करता था, और देश के लोगों में से साठ पुरुषों को जो अब भी नगर में थे।
hi.R: उसने नगर में से सैनिकों के प्रभारी अधिकारी को भी पकड़ा, और राजा के सात निकट सलाहकारों को जो अब भी नगर में थे। उसने सेनापति के सचिव को भी पकड़ा, जो देश के पुरुषों को सेना में भर्ती करने के लिए बुलाता था। उसने उन पुरुषों में से साठ को भी पकड़ा जो अब भी नगर में थे।

ru.L: И из города взял он одного евнуха, который был начальником над военными людьми, и семь человек из видевших лицо царя, которые были найдены в городе, и писца начальника войска, собиравшего народ земли, и шестьдесят человек из народа земли, найденных посреди города.
ru.B: Из города он взял одного придворного, который был поставлен над воинами, семь советников царя, которые были в городе, писца военачальника, набиравшего народ земли на войну, и шестьдесят человек из народа земли, которые ещё оставались в городе.
ru.R: Из города он забрал также придворного, который отвечал за воинов, и семерых ближайших советников царя, которые ещё были в городе. Он забрал писца командующего войском, который призывал мужчин страны на военную службу. Ещё он забрал шестьдесят из этих мужчин, которые ещё оставались в городе.

uk.L: А з міста він узяв одного євнуха, що був наглядачем над воїнами, і сімох мужів з тих, хто бачив обличчя царя, які знайшлися в місті, і писаря воєначальника, що збирав народ землі, і шістдесят мужів з народу землі, які знайшлися посеред міста.
uk.B: З міста він забрав придворного урядовця, що відповідав за воїнів, сімох царських радників, яких знайшли в місті, писаря воєначальника, що скликав людей краю на війну, і шістдесятьох людей краю, які ще були в місті.
uk.R: З міста він забрав також палацового урядовця, що відповідав за воїнів, і сімох найближчих царських радників, які ще були в місті. Він забрав писаря воєначальника, що скликав чоловіків краю служити у війську. Він забрав також шістдесятьох з тих чоловіків, які ще були в місті.

decisions.choice: seven of the king's advisers here; five in 2 Kings 25:19
decisions.reason: The verse follows 2 Kings 25:19, but where Kings has five men "who saw the face of the king", Jeremiah has seven. One number may have been miscopied; the Hebrew of each book is followed. Jeremiah also says the officer "had been" in charge, and "in the midst of the city" for "in the city".

decisions.choice: a royal officer
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:19, the word can mean a eunuch, but it was also a title for a high officer of the king (Genesis 37:36). Here it is a military officer in command of the soldiers.

decisions.choice: those who saw the face of the king: his closest advisers
decisions.reason: Only trusted counselors were allowed into the king's presence (Esther 1:14).

decisions.choice: the scribe of the commander of the army
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's Hebrew reads plainly "the scribe of the commander of the army", the secretary who kept the lists for calling men up. 2 Kings 25:19 can be read "the scribe, the commander of the army"; Jeremiah settles the sense.

decisions.choice: the people of the land: the landholding men of Judah
decisions.reason: Here the phrase names the citizens of Judah who held land and were called up to fight (34:19; 2 Kings 23:30). The sixty were probably leading men of that class.

decisions.choice: the king's advisers; mustered ... for war (Balanced); called up ... to serve in the army (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:19, Balanced and Readable say who "those who saw the king's face" were and what mustering was for. Readable splits the list into three sentences.

decisions.choice: eunuch (Literal); court officer (Balanced); palace official (Readable)
decisions.reason: As set for this word in Jeremiah and in 2 Kings 24:12, Literal keeps "eunuch", and Balanced and Readable say "court officer" and "palace official" (m2). 2 Kings 25:19 has "official" and "officer" here; this verse follows the wording set for Jeremiah instead.

decisions.choice: siete
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's Hebrew has seven of the king's advisers where 2 Kings 25:19 has five.

decisions.choice: "watu saba" (seven) where 2 Kings 25:19 has five
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse counts seven of the king's advisers; the rest keeps the 2 Kings wording.

decisions.choice: bảy người (seven)
decisions.reason: Jeremiah names seven of the king's advisers where 2 Kings 25:19 names five; the rest of the verse reuses the Kings wording.

decisions.choice: "일곱 명" where 2 Kings 25:19 has five; "60명" in figures
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's Hebrew counts seven of the king's advisers; the larger number is written in figures as set for this book.

decisions.choice: sete (here), cinco (2 Kings 25:19)
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 25:19 and changes the number of the king's advisers to seven, as the Hebrew does (m1).

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:19 with "ሰባት" (seven) for "አምስት" (five) of the king's advisers, and "በከተማዪቱ መካከል" (in the midst of the city).
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's Hebrew numbers seven; Balanced and Readable say "court officer" ("የቤተ መንግሥት ሹም") as the English.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 25:19, with "सात" and "रहा था"
decisions.reason: The verse copies the Hindi of 2 Kings 25:19 at each level. Jeremiah's Hebrew has seven of the king's advisers (2 Kings five), "had been overseer", and "in the midst of the city", which Literal keeps.

decisions.choice: был начальником; семь; посреди города
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 25:19 with "who had been" overseer, seven advisers for five (m1), and "in the midst of" the city; otherwise its wording at each level, with "евнух" (L) and "придворный" (B, R) as set there.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אוֹתָ֔ם נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב־טַבָּחִ֑ים וַיֹּ֧לֶךְ אוֹתָ֛ם אֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל רִבְלָֽתָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And took them Nebuzaradan chief of [the] guards, and brought them to [the] king of Babylon to Riblah.

en.L: And Nebuzaradan the chief of the guard took them and brought them to the king of Babylon, to Riblah.
en.B: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard led them away to Riblah and brought them before the king of Babylon.
en.R: Nebuzaradan, the commander of the guard, took them all to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

es.L: Y Nabuzaradán, jefe de la guardia, los tomó y los llevó al rey de Babilonia, a Ribla.
es.B: Nabuzaradán, capitán de la guardia, se los llevó a Ribla y los presentó ante el rey de Babilonia.
es.R: Nabuzaradán, el comandante de la guardia, los llevó a todos ante el rey de Babilonia, en Ribla.

fr.L: Et Nebouzaradân, chef des gardes, les prit et les conduisit vers le roi de Babylone, à Ribla.
fr.B: Nebouzaradân, le commandant de la garde, les emmena à Ribla et les amena devant le roi de Babylone.
fr.R: Nebouzaradân, le chef de la garde, les a tous emmenés au roi de Babylone, à Ribla.

sw.L: Naye Nebuzaradani mkuu wa walinzi akawachukua, akawaleta kwa mfalme wa Babeli huko Ribla.
sw.B: Nebuzaradani kamanda wa walinzi aliwachukua mpaka Ribla, akawaleta mbele ya mfalme wa Babeli.
sw.R: Nebuzaradani, kamanda wa walinzi, aliwapeleka wote kwa mfalme wa Babeli huko Ribla.

vi.L: Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy vệ binh, bắt họ và đem họ đến vua Ba-by-lôn tại Ríp-la.
vi.B: Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ, giải họ đến Ríp-la, trình vua Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, người chỉ huy đội cận vệ, đem tất cả họ đến vua Ba-by-lôn tại Ríp-la.

ko.L: 그리고 경호대장 느부사라단이 그들을 붙잡아 리블라에 있는 바빌론 왕에게로 끌고 갔다.
ko.B: 경호대장 느부사라단은 그들을 리블라로 끌고 가서 바빌론 왕 앞에 데려갔다.
ko.R: 경호대장 느부사라단은 그들을 모두 리블라에 있는 바빌론 왕에게 데려갔다.

pt.L: E Nebuzaradã, o chefe da guarda, os tomou e os levou ao rei da Babilônia, em Ribla.
pt.B: Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, levou-os a Ribla e os apresentou ao rei da Babilônia.
pt.R: Nebuzaradã, o comandante da guarda, levou todos eles ao rei da Babilônia, em Ribla.

am.L: የዘበኞቹም አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ወሰዳቸው፤ ወደ ሪብላም ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ አመጣቸው።
am.B: የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ወስዶ ወደ ሪብላ ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ አመጣቸው።
am.R: የዘበኞቹ አዛዥ ናቡዘረዳን ሁሉንም በሪብላ ወዳለው ወደ ባቢሎን ንጉሥ ወሰዳቸው።

hi.L: और अंगरक्षकों का प्रधान नबूज़रदान उन्हें लेकर रिबला में बाबुल के राजा के पास ले गया।
hi.B: अंगरक्षकों का प्रधान नबूज़रदान उन्हें रिबला ले गया और बाबुल के राजा के सामने पेश किया।
hi.R: अंगरक्षकों का सेनापति नबूज़रदान उन सब को रिबला में बाबुल के राजा के पास ले गया।

ru.L: И взял их Навузардан, начальник телохранителей, и привёл их к царю Вавилона в Ривлу.
ru.B: Навузардан, начальник стражи, увёл их в Ривлу и привёл к царю Вавилона.
ru.R: Навузардан, командир стражи, отвёл их всех к царю Вавилона в Ривлу.

uk.L: І Навузарадан, начальник варти, узяв їх і привів їх до царя Вавилону в Рівлу.
uk.B: Навузарадан, начальник варти, повів їх у Рівлу й поставив перед царем Вавилону.
uk.R: Навузарадан, начальник варти, привів їх усіх до царя Вавилону в Рівлу.

decisions.choice: the same words as 2 Kings 25:20
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 2 Kings 25:20, and the wording follows it.

decisions.choice: Riblah: Nebuchadrezzar's camp in Syria
decisions.reason: As in verse 9, where Zedekiah had been judged.

decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 2 Kings 25:20, and each level copies its Hindi.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 25:20
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew as 2 Kings 25:20 (m1).

source.text: וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אוֹתָם֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בָּבֶ֧ל וַיְמִתֵ֛ם בְּרִבְלָ֖ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֑ת וַיִּ֥גֶל יְהוּדָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And struck them [the] king of Babylon and put them to death at Riblah in [the] land of Hamath. And went into exile Judah from upon its land.

en.L: And the king of Babylon struck them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah went into exile from its land.
en.B: The king of Babylon had them struck down and executed at Riblah, in the land of Hamath. So Judah went into exile, away from its own land.
en.R: The king of Babylon had them killed there at Riblah, in the land of Hamath. So the people of Judah were taken away from their land as captives.

es.L: Y el rey de Babilonia los hirió y les dio muerte en Ribla, en la tierra de Hamat. Así fue llevado cautivo Judá de sobre su tierra.
es.B: El rey de Babilonia los hizo matar y ejecutar en Ribla, en la tierra de Hamat. Así Judá fue llevado al destierro, lejos de su propia tierra.
es.R: El rey de Babilonia los mandó matar allí, en Ribla, en la tierra de Hamat. Así la gente de Judá fue llevada prisionera lejos de su tierra.

fr.L: Et le roi de Babylone les frappa et les fit mourir à Ribla, au pays de Hamath. Et Juda fut déporté loin de sa terre.
fr.B: Le roi de Babylone les fit frapper et exécuter à Ribla, au pays de Hamath. Ainsi Juda fut emmené en exil, loin de sa terre.
fr.R: Le roi de Babylone les a fait tuer là, à Ribla, au pays de Hamath. Ainsi, le peuple de Juda a été emmené loin de son pays comme prisonnier.

sw.L: Naye mfalme wa Babeli akawapiga, akawaua huko Ribla katika nchi ya Hamathi. Basi Yuda akahamishwa kutoka katika nchi yake.
sw.B: Mfalme wa Babeli aliamuru wapigwe na kuuawa huko Ribla, katika nchi ya Hamathi. Basi Yuda walichukuliwa uhamishoni, mbali na nchi yao wenyewe.
sw.R: Mfalme wa Babeli aliamuru wauawe huko Ribla, katika nchi ya Hamathi. Basi watu wa Yuda walichukuliwa mateka kutoka katika nchi yao.

vi.L: Vua Ba-by-lôn đánh họ và giết họ tại Ríp-la trong xứ Ha-mát. Vậy Giu-đa bị lưu đày khỏi đất mình.
vi.B: Vua Ba-by-lôn cho đánh giết họ tại Ríp-la, trong xứ Ha-mát. Vậy Giu-đa bị lưu đày khỏi đất của mình.
vi.R: Vua Ba-by-lôn cho giết họ tại Ríp-la, trong xứ Ha-mát. Vậy dân Giu-đa bị bắt đem khỏi đất mình làm tù binh.

ko.L: 그리고 바빌론 왕이 하맛 땅 리블라에서 그들을 쳐 죽였다. 이렇게 유다가 자기 땅에서 사로잡혀 갔다.
ko.B: 바빌론 왕은 하맛 땅 리블라에서 그들을 쳐 죽이게 했다. 이렇게 유다는 자기 땅에서 사로잡혀 갔다.
ko.R: 바빌론 왕은 하맛 땅 리블라에서 그들을 죽이게 했다. 이렇게 유다 백성은 포로가 되어 자기 땅에서 끌려갔다.

pt.L: E o rei da Babilônia os feriu e os matou em Ribla, na terra de Hamate. E Judá foi levado para o exílio, para fora da sua terra.
pt.B: O rei da Babilônia mandou feri-los e executá-los em Ribla, na terra de Hamate. Assim Judá foi levado para o exílio, para longe da sua própria terra.

decisions.choice: verses 28-30 are part of the Hebrew text; the Greek lacks them
alternatives: leave out verses 28-30 with the Greek
decisions.reason: As far as is known from general knowledge, the Septuagint of Jeremiah does not have verses 28-30 and goes straight from verse 27 to the release of Jehoiachin (verse 31). 2 Kings 25 does not have them either. This translation follows the Hebrew (see the note at 1:1).

decisions.choice: the seventh year: the exile of Jehoiachin in 597 BC, with a smaller number than 2 Kings 24
alternatives: a deportation from the towns of Judah before Jehoiachin's surrender
decisions.reason: Nebuchadrezzar's seventh year is the year he took Jerusalem the first time and carried off King Jehoiachin (2 Kings 24:10-16). 2 Kings 24:12 calls it his eighth year, probably counting the year he came to the throne as his first; the two books count his reign in different ways. 2 Kings 24:14 says ten thousand were taken then, and 24:16 seven thousand fighting men and a thousand craftsmen, far more than 3,023. This list may count only the adult men, or only the people of one class or from certain towns, or it may come from a Babylonian record of a particular group. What it counted is not known.

decisions.choice: Judeans: people of Judah
decisions.reason: The word names the people of the kingdom of Judah, as in 32:12 and 40:11-12.

decisions.choice: this is the people: a list follows
decisions.reason: The words introduce the three numbers that follow in verses 28-30 and their total.

decisions.choice: the seventh year that he was king; he took (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says whose years are counted and repeats the verb so that each number is a full sentence.
Verses 28-30 appear only in Jeremiah. Thousands are written with a space, as set for these books.

decisions.choice: the large numbers in figures ("3,023")
decisions.reason: Large counts are written in figures, as the English does and as most Swahili blocks of Kings and Chronicles do; smaller numbers stay in words.

decisions.choice: 3.023 (figures, with a point between thousands)
alternatives: ba nghìn không trăm hai mươi ba
decisions.reason: Verses 28-30 are not in 2 Kings. Counts this large are written in figures, as the English writes them, with the Vietnamese thousands point.

decisions.choice: "3,023명" in figures at every level
decisions.reason: The terms note: years and large numbers in figures [1 Chr 27:12].

Verses 28-30 have no parallel in 2 Kings. As portuguese-style.md section 5 sets, long numbers are written in figures, with a point for thousands; the years are ordinals in words, as the dates of the chapter. "Judeus" (L, B) and "pessoas de Judá" (R) as 41:3.

decisions.choice: verses 28-30 have no parallel in 2 Kings and are drafted from Jeremiah's Hebrew: the numbers 3023, 832, 745 and 4600 are Jeremiah's, not the 10,000 or 8000 of 2 Kings 24:14-16; the exile verbs are "አፈለሰ" (Literal) and "ማርኮ ወሰደ" (Balanced, Readable), as the Kings list.
decisions.reason: The meaning decisions note the smaller numbers; the Amharic gives them in figures and does not reconcile them with 2 Kings.

decisions.choice: drafted without a parallel; "निर्वासित करना" (L, B), "बंदी बनाकर ले जाना" (R)
decisions.reason: Verses 28-30 have no parallel in 2 Kings. The verb for exile keeps the wording of 2 Kings 25:11 at each level.

decisions.choice: переселил (L); увёл в изгнание (B); угнал в плен (R); иудеи
decisions.reason: Verses 28-30 have no parallel in 2 Kings (m1). The exile verb keeps the wording of 2 Kings 24:14 at each level, and "Judeans" are "иудеи", as 2 Kings 25:25 in this translation (m3).
Figures as the English gives them; Russian writes no thin space in a number of four digits, as the style guide sets.

fr.L: La vingt-troisième année de Nabuchodonosor, Nebouzaradân, chef des gardes, déporta, parmi les Judéens, sept cent quarante-cinq personnes ; toutes les personnes [étaient] quatre mille six cents.
fr.B: La vingt-troisième année de Nabuchodonosor, Nebouzaradân, le commandant de la garde, emmena en exil sept cent quarante-cinq Judéens. En tout, il y eut quatre mille six cents personnes.
fr.R: La vingt-troisième année du règne de Nabuchodonosor, Nebouzaradân, le chef de la garde, a encore emmené sept cent quarante-cinq personnes de Juda. En tout, quatre mille six cents personnes ont été emmenées.

sw.L: Katika mwaka wa ishirini na tatu wa Nebukadreza, Nebuzaradani mkuu wa walinzi aliwahamisha katika Wayahudi watu 745; watu wote [walikuwa] 4,600.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa ishirini na tatu wa Nebukadreza, Nebuzaradani kamanda wa walinzi aliwachukua uhamishoni Wayahudi 745. Kwa jumla walikuwa watu 4,600.
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa ishirini na tatu wa utawala wa Nebukadreza, Nebuzaradani, kamanda wa walinzi, aliwachukua watu wengine 745 kutoka Yuda. Kwa jumla watu 4,600 walichukuliwa.

vi.L: Năm thứ hai mươi ba đời Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa, Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy vệ binh, bắt đi lưu đày 745 người Giu-đa; tổng cộng [là] 4.600 người.
vi.B: Năm thứ hai mươi ba đời Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa, Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ, bắt đi lưu đày 745 người Giu-đa. Tổng cộng có 4.600 người.
vi.R: Năm thứ hai mươi ba đời Nê-bu-cát-rết-sa, Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, người chỉ huy đội cận vệ, bắt thêm 745 người từ Giu-đa. Tổng cộng có 4.600 người bị bắt đi.

ko.L: 느부갓레살의 제23년에 경호대장 느부사라단이 유다 사람 745명을 사로잡아 갔다. 모두 4,600명이다.
ko.B: 느부갓레살이 다스린 지 23년째 되는 해에 경호대장 느부사라단이 유다 사람 745명을 사로잡아 갔다. 모두 합하여 4,600명이었다.
ko.R: 느부갓레살이 왕이 된 지 23년째 되는 해에 경호대장 느부사라단이 유다에서 745명을 더 잡아갔다. 잡혀간 사람은 모두 4,600명이었다.

pt.L: No vigésimo terceiro ano de Nabucodorosor, Nebuzaradã, o chefe da guarda, levou para o exílio, dos judeus, 745 pessoas; todas as pessoas [foram] 4.600.
pt.B: No vigésimo terceiro ano de Nabucodorosor, Nebuzaradã, capitão da guarda, levou para o exílio 745 judeus. Ao todo foram 4.600 pessoas.
pt.R: No vigésimo terceiro ano em que Nabucodorosor era rei, Nebuzaradã, o comandante da guarda, levou mais 745 pessoas de Judá. Ao todo, 4.600 pessoas foram levadas.

am.L: በናቡከደነፆር በሃያ ሦስተኛው ዓመት የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን ከአይሁድ 745 ነፍሳትን አፈለሰ፤ ነፍሳቱ ሁሉ 4600 [ነበሩ]።
am.B: በናቡከደነፆር በሃያ ሦስተኛው ዓመት የዘበኞቹ አለቃ ናቡዘረዳን 745 አይሁድን ማርኮ ወሰደ። በአጠቃላይ 4600 ሰዎች ነበሩ።
am.R: ናቡከደነፆር በነገሠ በሃያ ሦስተኛው ዓመት የዘበኞቹ አዛዥ ናቡዘረዳን ከይሁዳ ሌሎች 745 ሰዎችን ማርኮ ወሰደ። በአጠቃላይ 4600 ሰዎች ተማርከው ተወሰዱ።

hi.L: नबूकदरेस्सर के तेईसवें वर्ष में अंगरक्षकों का प्रधान नबूज़रदान यहूदियों में से 745 प्राणी निर्वासित करके ले गया; सब प्राणी 4,600 [थे]।
hi.B: नबूकदरेस्सर के तेईसवें वर्ष में अंगरक्षकों का प्रधान नबूज़रदान 745 यहूदियों को निर्वासन में ले गया। कुल मिलाकर 4,600 लोग थे।
hi.R: नबूकदरेस्सर के तेईसवें वर्ष में अंगरक्षकों का सेनापति नबूज़रदान यहूदा से 745 और लोगों को बंदी बनाकर ले गया। कुल मिलाकर 4,600 लोग ले जाए गए।

ru.L: В двадцать третий год Навуходорносора переселил Навузардан, начальник телохранителей, из иудеев 745 душ; всех душ [было] 4600.
ru.B: В двадцать третий год Навуходорносора Навузардан, начальник стражи, увёл в изгнание 745 иудеев. Всего было 4600 человек.
ru.R: В двадцать третий год царствования Навуходорносора Навузардан, командир стражи, угнал в плен ещё 745 человек из Иуды. Всего угнали 4600 человек.

uk.L: У двадцять третьому році Навуходоносора Навузарадан, начальник варти, вивів у полон з юдеїв 745 душ; усіх душ [було] 4600.
uk.B: У двадцять третьому році Навуходоносора Навузарадан, начальник варти, вивів у полон 745 юдеїв. Усього було 4600 людей.
uk.R: У двадцять третьому році Навуходоносора Навузарадан, начальник варти, забрав ще 745 людей з Юди. Усього було забрано 4600 людей.

decisions.choice: the twenty-third year: a third deportation, about 582 BC
decisions.reason: No other passage tells of this deportation, five years after the fall of Jerusalem. It may have been a punishment after the murder of Gedaliah and the Babylonian soldiers at Mizpah (41:1-3), or part of a later campaign in the region; the Jewish historian Josephus speaks of a campaign against Ammon and Moab in Nebuchadrezzar's twenty-third year. This is stated from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: all the persons: the total of the three lists
decisions.reason: The three numbers add up exactly: 3,023 and 832 and 745 make 4,600.

decisions.choice: Nebuzaradan again
decisions.reason: The same officer who burned the city and led the second exile (verses 12-16) leads the third.

decisions.choice: more; were taken (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable adds "more" to show that this group is added to the others, and "were taken" to complete the total.

decisions.choice: "अंगरक्षकों का प्रधान" (L, B); "अंगरक्षकों का सेनापति" (R)
decisions.reason: Nebuzaradan's title keeps the wording of 2 Kings 25 and verse 12 at each level.

decisions.choice: ещё
decisions.reason: Readable adds "ещё" to show that this group is added to the others, as the English adds "more".

source.text: וַיְהִי֩ בִשְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וָשֶׁ֜בַע שָׁנָ֗ה לְגָלוּת֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ן מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֔ה בִּשְׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ חֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ נָשָׂ֡א אֱוִ֣יל מְרֹדַךְ֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בָּבֶ֜ל בִּשְׁנַ֣ת מַלְכֻת֗וֹ אֶת־רֹאשׁ֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיֹּצֵ֥א אוֹת֖וֹ מִבֵּ֥ית הַכְּלֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was in [the] thirty and seven year of [the] exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in [the] twelfth month, on [the] twenty and five of the month, lifted Evil-Merodach king of Babylon, in [the] year of his reign, [the] head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him out from [the] house of the imprisonment.

en.L: And it came about in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fifth [day] of the month, [that] Evil-Merodach king of Babylon, in the year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah and brought him out from the house of imprisonment.
en.B: In the thirty-seventh year after Jehoiachin king of Judah went into exile, on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month, Evil-Merodach king of Babylon, in the year he became king, showed favor to Jehoiachin king of Judah and brought him out of prison.
en.R: Jehoiachin king of Judah had been in exile for thirty-seven years. Then Evil-Merodach became king of Babylon. In the year he became king, on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month, he showed Jehoiachin favor and brought him out of prison.

es.L: Y sucedió en el año treinta y siete del cautiverio de Joaquín, rey de Judá, en el mes duodécimo, a los veinticinco [días] del mes, [que] Evil-merodac, rey de Babilonia, en el año de su reinado, levantó la cabeza de Joaquín, rey de Judá, y lo sacó de la casa de la prisión.
es.B: En el año treinta y siete del destierro de Joaquín, rey de Judá, el día veinticinco del mes duodécimo, Evil-merodac, rey de Babilonia, en el año en que comenzó a reinar, le mostró su favor a Joaquín, rey de Judá, y lo sacó de la cárcel.
es.R: Joaquín, rey de Judá, llevaba treinta y siete años en el destierro. Entonces Evil-merodac llegó a ser rey de Babilonia. En el año en que comenzó a reinar, el día veinticinco del mes duodécimo, le mostró su favor a Joaquín y lo sacó de la cárcel.

fr.L: Et il arriva, la trente-septième année de l’exil de Joïakin, roi de Juda, au douzième mois, le vingt-cinq du mois, [qu’]Évil-Merodak, roi de Babylone, l’année de son règne, releva la tête de Joïakin, roi de Juda, et le fit sortir de la maison de détention.
fr.B: La trente-septième année de l’exil de Joïakin, roi de Juda, le vingt-cinq du douzième mois, Évil-Merodak, roi de Babylone, l’année même où il devint roi, accorda sa faveur à Joïakin, roi de Juda, et le fit sortir de prison.
fr.R: Joïakin, roi de Juda, était en exil depuis trente-sept ans. Alors Évil-Merodak est devenu roi de Babylone. L’année où il est devenu roi, le vingt-cinq du douzième mois, il a été bon pour Joïakin et l’a fait sortir de prison.

sw.L: Ikawa katika mwaka wa thelathini na saba wa uhamisho wa Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda, katika mwezi wa kumi na mbili, siku ya ishirini na tano ya mwezi, Evil-merodaki mfalme wa Babeli, katika mwaka wa kutawala kwake, akakiinua kichwa cha Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda, akamtoa katika nyumba ya kifungo.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na saba wa uhamisho wa Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda, siku ya ishirini na tano ya mwezi wa kumi na mbili, Evil-merodaki mfalme wa Babeli, katika mwaka alioanza kutawala, alimwonyesha Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda fadhili, akamtoa gerezani.
sw.R: Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda alikuwa amekaa uhamishoni kwa miaka thelathini na saba. Kisha Evil-merodaki akawa mfalme wa Babeli. Katika mwaka alioanza kutawala, siku ya ishirini na tano ya mwezi wa kumi na mbili, alimwonyesha Yehoyakini fadhili, akamtoa gerezani.

vi.L: Xảy ra vào năm thứ ba mươi bảy kể từ khi Giê-hô-gia-kin vua Giu-đa bị lưu đày, tháng thứ mười hai, ngày hai mươi lăm trong tháng, Ê-vinh-Mê-rô-đác vua Ba-by-lôn, trong năm vua ấy lên ngôi, ngẩng đầu Giê-hô-gia-kin vua Giu-đa lên và đưa ông ra khỏi nhà giam.
vi.B: Năm thứ ba mươi bảy kể từ khi Giê-hô-gia-kin vua Giu-đa bị lưu đày, vào ngày hai mươi lăm tháng mười hai, Ê-vinh-Mê-rô-đác vua Ba-by-lôn, trong năm mới lên ngôi, đã ban ơn cho Giê-hô-gia-kin vua Giu-đa và thả ông ra khỏi ngục.
vi.R: Giê-hô-gia-kin vua Giu-đa đã bị lưu đày ba mươi bảy năm. Bấy giờ Ê-vinh-Mê-rô-đác lên làm vua Ba-by-lôn. Trong năm lên ngôi, vào ngày hai mươi lăm tháng mười hai, vua ấy ban ơn cho Giê-hô-gia-kin và thả ông ra khỏi ngục.

ko.L: 그리고 유다 왕 여호야긴이 사로잡혀 간 지 37년째 되는 해 열두째 달 이십오일에, 바빌론 왕 에윌므로닥이 왕이 된 그해에 유다 왕 여호야긴의 머리를 들어 그를 감옥에서 나오게 했다.
ko.B: 유다 왕 여호야긴이 사로잡혀 간 지 37년째 되는 해 열두째 달 이십오일에, 바빌론 왕 에윌므로닥이 왕이 된 그해에 유다 왕 여호야긴에게 은혜를 베풀어 그를 감옥에서 풀어 주었다.
ko.R: 유다 왕 여호야긴이 포로로 잡혀간 지 37년이 되었다. 그때 에윌므로닥이 바빌론의 왕이 되었다. 그는 왕이 된 그해 열두째 달 이십오일에 여호야긴에게 은혜를 베풀어 그를 감옥에서 풀어 주었다.

pt.L: E aconteceu, no trigésimo sétimo ano do exílio de Joaquim, rei de Judá, no décimo segundo mês, no [dia] vinte e cinco do mês, [que] Evil-Merodaque, rei da Babilônia, no ano do seu reinado, levantou a cabeça de Joaquim, rei de Judá, e o tirou da casa da prisão.
pt.B: No trigésimo sétimo ano do exílio de Joaquim, rei de Judá, no dia vinte e cinco do décimo segundo mês, Evil-Merodaque, rei da Babilônia, no ano em que começou a reinar, mostrou favor a Joaquim, rei de Judá, e o libertou da prisão.
pt.R: Joaquim, rei de Judá, já estava no exílio havia trinta e sete anos. Então Evil-Merodaque se tornou rei da Babilônia. No ano em que se tornou rei, no dia vinte e cinco do décimo segundo mês, ele mostrou favor a Joaquim e o tirou da prisão.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ዮአኪን በተማረከ በሠላሳ ሰባተኛው ዓመት፣ በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር፣ ከወሩም በሃያ አምስተኛው [ቀን] የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ዮርማሮዴቅ በነገሠበት ዓመት የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የዮአኪንን ራስ ቀና አደረገ፤ ከወህኒ ቤትም አወጣው።
am.B: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ዮአኪን በተማረከ በሠላሳ ሰባተኛው ዓመት፣ በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር በሃያ አምስተኛው ቀን የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ዮርማሮዴቅ በነገሠበት ዓመት ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለዮአኪን ሞገስ አሳየው፤ ከወህኒ ቤትም አወጣው።
am.R: የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ዮአኪን ተማርኮ ሠላሳ ሰባት ዓመት ሆኖት ነበር። ከዚያም ዮርማሮዴቅ የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ሆነ። በነገሠበትም ዓመት በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር በሃያ አምስተኛው ቀን ለዮአኪን ሞገስ አሳየው፤ ከእስር ቤትም አወጣው።

hi.L: और यहूदा के राजा यहोयाकीन के निर्वासन के सैंतीसवें वर्ष में, बारहवें महीने में, महीने के पच्चीसवें [दिन] ऐसा हुआ [कि] बाबुल के राजा एवील-मरोदक ने, जिस वर्ष वह राजा बना, यहूदा के राजा यहोयाकीन का सिर ऊँचा किया और उसे बंदीगृह से बाहर निकाल लाया।
hi.B: यहूदा के राजा यहोयाकीन के निर्वासन के सैंतीसवें वर्ष में, बारहवें महीने के पच्चीसवें दिन, बाबुल के राजा एवील-मरोदक ने, जिस वर्ष वह राजा बना, यहूदा के राजा यहोयाकीन पर कृपा की और उसे बंदीगृह से बाहर निकाल लाया।
hi.R: यहूदा के राजा यहोयाकीन को निर्वासन में सैंतीस वर्ष हो चुके थे। तब एवील-मरोदक बाबुल का राजा बना। जिस वर्ष वह राजा बना, उसी वर्ष बारहवें महीने के पच्चीसवें दिन उसने यहोयाकीन पर कृपा की और उसे बंदीगृह से बाहर निकाल लिया।

ru.L: И было в тридцать седьмой год переселения Иехонии, царя Иуды, в двенадцатый месяц, в двадцать пятый [день] месяца, [что] Евилмеродах, царь Вавилона, в год своего царствования поднял голову Иехонии, царя Иуды, и вывел его из дома заключения.
ru.B: В тридцать седьмой год изгнания Иехонии, царя Иуды, в двадцать пятый день двенадцатого месяца, Евилмеродах, царь Вавилона, в год своего воцарения оказал милость Иехонии, царю Иуды, и вывел его из темницы.
ru.R: Иехония, царь Иуды, провёл в плену тридцать семь лет. Тогда царём Вавилона стал Евилмеродах. В год, когда он стал царём, в двадцать пятый день двенадцатого месяца, он проявил милость к Иехонии и вывел его из темницы.

uk.L: І сталося в тридцять сьомому році полону Єгояхина, царя Юдеї, у дванадцятому місяці, двадцять пʼятого [дня] місяця, [що] Евіл-Меродах, цар Вавилону, у рік свого царювання підніс голову Єгояхина, царя Юдеї, і вивів його з дому увʼязнення.
uk.B: У тридцять сьомому році після того, як Єгояхин, цар Юдеї, пішов у полон, двадцять пʼятого дня дванадцятого місяця, Евіл-Меродах, цар Вавилону, у рік, коли став царем, виявив ласку Єгояхину, цареві Юдеї, і вивів його з вʼязниці.
uk.R: Єгояхин, цар Юдеї, був у полоні тридцять сім років. Тоді царем Вавилону став Евіл-Меродах. У рік, коли він став царем, двадцять пʼятого дня дванадцятого місяця, він виявив Єгояхину ласку й вивів його з вʼязниці.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:27: the twenty-seventh day
decisions.reason: The verse follows 2 Kings 25:27, but Kings dates the release to the twenty-seventh of the month, not the twenty-fifth. The difference may come from copying, or from counting the order and the release separately. Jeremiah also adds "and brought him out", where Kings has only "from the house of imprisonment".

decisions.choice: lifted up the head: showed favor and released
decisions.reason: To lift up someone's head is to raise him from disgrace to favor, as Pharaoh lifted up the head of his cupbearer and brought him out of prison (Genesis 40:13, 20).

decisions.choice: Evil-Merodach: the Babylonian king Awel-Marduk
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:27, the name is the Hebrew form of Awel-Marduk, "man of Marduk", Nebuchadrezzar's son, who reigned for about two years. In Hebrew the first part sounds like the word for "foolish", which may be no more than the way the name was heard.

decisions.choice: Jehoiachin: the king Jeremiah also calls Jeconiah and Coniah
decisions.reason: The verse uses the form Jehoiachin, as Kings does. Elsewhere Jeremiah calls the same king Jeconiah (24:1; 27:20) and Coniah (22:24, 28), and said that no son of his would sit on David's throne (22:30).

decisions.choice: the thirty-seventh year: about 561 BC
decisions.reason: Jehoiachin was taken to Babylon at eighteen, in 597 BC (2 Kings 24:8-15). Thirty-seven years later, in the year Evil-Merodach came to the throne, he was about fifty-five. The twelfth month falls at the end of winter.

decisions.choice: showed favor ... and brought him out (Balanced); showed Jehoiachin favor (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:27, Balanced and Readable give the sense of the idiom instead of the picture of lifting the head, and say "in the year he became king" for "in the year of his reign". Readable splits the date into short sentences. Balanced says "the thirty-seventh year after Jehoiachin ... went into exile" for "the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin".

decisions.choice: a los veinticinco [días]; Joaquín
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's Hebrew has the twenty-fifth day where 2 Kings 25:27 has the twenty-seventh; the king's name keeps the form Jehoiachin (Joaquín), as there.

decisions.choice: "siku ya ishirini na tano" (the 25th) where 2 Kings 25:27 has the 27th
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse gives a different day; the rest keeps the 2 Kings wording, including "akakiinua kichwa" at Literal.

decisions.choice: ngày hai mươi lăm (the twenty-fifth)
decisions.reason: Jeremiah has the twenty-fifth day where 2 Kings 25:27 has the twenty-seventh; Vietnamese follows the Hebrew of each, and keeps the Kings wording otherwise.

decisions.choice: "머리를 들어" (L); "은혜를 베풀어 ... 풀어 주었다" (B, R), as 2 Kings 25:27; the twenty-fifth day
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's Hebrew dates the release two days before 2 Kings 25:27; Korean follows each text and keeps the Kings idiom.

decisions.choice: vinte e cinco (here), vinte e sete (2 Kings 25:27)
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the Portuguese of 2 Kings 25:27 and changes only the day, as the Hebrew does (m1); "Joaquim" for Jehoiachin, apart from "Jeoaquim", as 1:3 sets it.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:27 with "በሃያ አምስተኛው" (the twenty-fifth day) for "በሃያ ሰባተኛው" (the twenty-seventh), and "ከወህኒ ቤትም አወጣው" (brought him out) where 2 Kings has only "from the house of imprisonment".
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's Hebrew gives a different day and adds the verb; the rest is copied.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 25:27, with the twenty-fifth day and "उसे बंदीगृह से बाहर निकाल लाया"
decisions.reason: The verse copies the Hindi of 2 Kings 25:27 at each level. Jeremiah's Hebrew has the twenty-fifth day (2 Kings the twenty-seventh) and a separate verb, "brought him out from the house of imprisonment".

decisions.choice: двадцать пятый; вывел его из
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 25:27 has the twenty-seventh day (m1); here the twenty-fifth, "in the year of his reign" (Literal "царствования"), and "brought him out", which each level says with "вывел". Jehoiachin keeps the form "Иехония" of 2 Kings 24-25 in this translation (m4).

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ טֹב֑וֹת וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־כִּסְא֔וֹ מִמַּ֗עַל לְכִסֵּ֧א הַמְּלָכִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ בְּבָבֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he spoke with him good things, and set his seat above [the] seat of the kings who [were] with him in Babylon.

en.L: And he spoke good things with him and set his seat above the seat of the kings who [were] with him in Babylon.
en.B: He spoke kindly to him and gave him a seat of honor above the seats of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.
en.R: He spoke kindly to Jehoiachin and gave him a place of honor, higher than that of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.

es.L: Y le habló cosas buenas, y puso su asiento por encima del asiento de los reyes que [estaban] con él en Babilonia.
es.B: Le habló con bondad y le dio un asiento de honor por encima de los asientos de los demás reyes que estaban con él en Babilonia.
es.R: Le habló con bondad a Joaquín y le dio un lugar de honor, más alto que el de los demás reyes que estaban con él en Babilonia.

fr.L: Et il lui parla avec bonté, et il plaça son siège au-dessus du siège des rois qui [étaient] avec lui à Babylone.
fr.B: Il lui parla avec bienveillance et lui donna une place d’honneur au-dessus de celle des autres rois qui étaient avec lui à Babylone.
fr.R: Il a parlé gentiment à Joïakin et lui a donné une place d’honneur, plus haute que celle des autres rois qui étaient avec lui à Babylone.

sw.L: Naye akasema naye mambo mema, akakiweka kiti chake juu ya kiti cha wafalme waliokuwa pamoja naye huko Babeli.
sw.B: Alizungumza naye kwa wema, akampa kiti cha heshima juu ya viti vya wafalme wengine waliokuwa pamoja naye huko Babeli.
sw.R: Alizungumza na Yehoyakini kwa wema, akampa nafasi ya heshima, ya juu kuliko ya wafalme wengine waliokuwa pamoja naye huko Babeli.

vi.L: Vua ấy nói những lời tốt đẹp với ông và đặt ngai ông cao hơn ngai của các vua ở với vua ấy tại Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Vua ấy nói năng tử tế với ông và cho ông một chỗ ngồi danh dự, cao hơn chỗ ngồi của các vua khác ở với vua ấy tại Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Vua ấy nói năng tử tế với Giê-hô-gia-kin và cho ông một chỗ danh dự, cao hơn chỗ của các vua khác ở với vua ấy tại Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그와 좋은 말을 나누고, 그의 자리를 바빌론에서 그와 함께 있던 왕들의 자리보다 높이 두었다.
ko.B: 그는 여호야긴에게 친절하게 말하고, 바빌론에서 그와 함께 있던 다른 왕들의 자리보다 높은 영예로운 자리를 주었다.
ko.R: 그는 여호야긴에게 친절하게 말했다. 그리고 바빌론에서 그와 함께 지내던 다른 왕들보다 더 높은 명예로운 자리를 그에게 주었다.

pt.L: E falou com ele coisas boas e pôs o seu trono acima do trono dos reis que [estavam] com ele na Babilônia.
pt.B: Ele falou bondosamente com Joaquim e lhe deu um lugar de honra acima dos lugares dos outros reis que estavam com ele na Babilônia.
pt.R: Ele falou com bondade com Joaquim e lhe deu um lugar de honra, mais alto que o dos outros reis que estavam com ele na Babilônia.

am.L: ከእርሱም ጋር መልካም ነገርን ተናገረ፤ ዙፋኑንም በባቢሎን ከእርሱ ጋር ከነበሩት ከነገሥታቱ ዙፋን በላይ አደረገለት።
am.B: በደግነት አነጋገረው፤ በባቢሎንም ከእርሱ ጋር ከነበሩት ነገሥታት ወንበር በላይ የክብር ወንበር ሰጠው።
am.R: ዮአኪንን በደግነት አነጋገረው። በባቢሎን ከእርሱ ጋር ከነበሩት ሌሎች ነገሥታት በላይ የክብር ቦታ ሰጠው።

hi.L: और उसने उससे भली बातें कीं, और उसका आसन उन राजाओं के आसन से ऊँचा किया जो बाबुल में उसके साथ [थे]।
hi.B: उसने उससे कृपा से बात की और उसे उन दूसरे राजाओं के आसनों से ऊँचा आदर का आसन दिया जो बाबुल में उसके साथ थे।
hi.R: उसने यहोयाकीन से कृपा से बात की और उसे आदर का स्थान दिया, जो बाबुल में उसके साथ रहनेवाले दूसरे राजाओं के स्थान से ऊँचा था।

ru.L: И говорил он с ним доброе, и поставил его престол выше престола царей, которые [были] с ним в Вавилоне.
ru.B: Он говорил с ним ласково и дал ему почётное место выше мест других царей, которые были с ним в Вавилоне.
ru.R: Он ласково говорил с Иехонией и дал ему почётное место, выше, чем у других царей, которые были с ним в Вавилоне.

uk.L: І він говорив з ним добре і поставив його престол вище від престолу царів, що [були] з ним у Вавилоні.
uk.B: Він говорив з ним ласкаво й дав йому почесне місце, вище за місця інших царів, що були з ним у Вавилоні.
uk.R: Він ласкаво говорив з Єгояхином і дав йому почесне місце, вище, ніж в інших царів, що були з ним у Вавилоні.

decisions.choice: the same words as 2 Kings 25:28
decisions.reason: The verse is the same as 2 Kings 25:28 apart from the form of the word "above", and the wording follows it.

decisions.choice: spoke good things with him: spoke kindly to him
decisions.reason: To speak "good things" is to speak kindly and favorably (12:6), perhaps also promising him good treatment.

decisions.choice: the seat above the other kings: first place among the captive kings
decisions.reason: The Babylonian kings kept rulers of conquered lands at their court. Jehoiachin was given a seat higher than all of them, a public sign of honor.

decisions.choice: a seat of honor; a place of honor (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:28, Balanced and Readable say what setting his seat above the others meant, and add "other" for the kings.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 25:28
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 2 Kings 25:28, and each level copies its Hindi.

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 25:28
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew as 2 Kings 25:28 (m1).

source.text: וְשִׁנָּ֕ה אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י כִלְא֑וֹ וְאָכַ֨ל לֶ֧חֶם לְפָנָ֛יו תָּמִ֖יד כָּל־יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he changed [the] clothes of his imprisonment, and he ate bread before him continually all [the] days of his life.

en.L: And he changed his prison clothes, and he ate bread continually before him all the days of his life.
en.B: So Jehoiachin put off his prison clothes, and for the rest of his life he ate regularly at the king's table.
en.R: Jehoiachin no longer had to wear prison clothes. For the rest of his life he ate his meals at the king's table.

es.L: Y cambió sus vestidos de prisión, y comió pan continuamente delante de él todos los días de su vida.
es.B: Así Joaquín se quitó la ropa de prisionero, y por el resto de su vida comió siempre a la mesa del rey.
es.R: Joaquín ya no tuvo que usar ropa de prisionero. Por el resto de su vida comió a la mesa del rey.

fr.L: Et il changea ses vêtements de prison, et il mangea le pain continuellement devant lui, tous les jours de sa vie.
fr.B: Joïakin quitta ses vêtements de prisonnier, et tout le reste de sa vie il mangea régulièrement à la table du roi.
fr.R: Joïakin n’a plus eu à porter des vêtements de prisonnier. Jusqu’à la fin de sa vie, il a pris ses repas à la table du roi.

sw.L: Naye akabadilisha mavazi yake ya kifungo, akala chakula daima mbele yake siku zote za maisha yake.
sw.B: Basi Yehoyakini akayavua mavazi yake ya gerezani, na kwa maisha yake yote yaliyobaki akala daima mezani pa mfalme.
sw.R: Yehoyakini hakuvaa tena mavazi ya gerezani. Kwa maisha yake yote yaliyobaki alikula chakula chake mezani pa mfalme.

vi.L: Ông thay áo tù, và ông ăn bánh thường xuyên trước mặt vua ấy mọi ngày trong đời ông.
vi.B: Vậy Giê-hô-gia-kin cởi bỏ áo tù, và suốt quãng đời còn lại ông thường xuyên ăn tại bàn vua.
vi.R: Giê-hô-gia-kin không còn phải mặc áo tù nữa. Suốt quãng đời còn lại, ông được ăn uống tại bàn của vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그의 죄수복을 갈아입었고, 그의 평생 동안 늘 그 앞에서 빵을 먹었다.
ko.B: 그래서 여호야긴은 죄수복을 벗었고, 평생 동안 늘 왕의 식탁에서 먹었다.
ko.R: 여호야긴은 더 이상 죄수복을 입지 않아도 되었다. 그는 죽을 때까지 왕의 식탁에서 함께 먹었다.

pt.L: E ele trocou as roupas da sua prisão, e comeu pão continuamente diante dele todos os dias da sua vida.
pt.B: Assim Joaquim deixou as roupas de prisioneiro e, pelo resto da vida, comia sempre à mesa do rei.
pt.R: Joaquim não precisou mais usar roupas de prisioneiro. Pelo resto da vida, ele comia sempre à mesa do rei.

am.L: የወህኒ ቤት ልብሱንም ለወጠ፤ በሕይወቱም ዘመን ሁሉ ዘወትር በፊቱ እንጀራ በላ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ዮአኪን የወህኒ ቤት ልብሱን አወለቀ፤ በቀረው ዕድሜውም ሁሉ ዘወትር በንጉሡ ማዕድ ይበላ ነበር።
am.R: ዮአኪን ከዚያ በኋላ የእስረኛ ልብስ መልበስ አላስፈለገውም። በቀረው ሕይወቱ ሁሉ ምግቡን በንጉሡ ማዕድ ይበላ ነበር።

hi.L: और उसने अपने बंदीगृह के वस्त्र बदल डाले, और वह अपने जीवन के सब दिन नित्य उसके सामने रोटी खाता रहा।
hi.B: इसलिए यहोयाकीन ने अपने बंदीगृह के वस्त्र उतार दिए, और जीवन भर वह नियमित रूप से राजा की मेज़ पर भोजन करता रहा।
hi.R: यहोयाकीन को अब बंदीगृह के कपड़े नहीं पहनने पड़े। जीवन भर वह राजा की मेज़ पर भोजन करता रहा।

ru.L: И сменил он одежды своего заключения, и ел хлеб перед ним постоянно во все дни своей жизни.
ru.B: Иехония снял с себя одежду узника и до конца своей жизни постоянно ел за царским столом.
ru.R: Иехонии больше не нужно было носить одежду узника. До конца жизни он ел за столом царя.

uk.L: І він змінив свій тюремний одяг, і їв хліб постійно перед ним усі дні свого життя.
uk.B: Тож Єгояхин скинув свій тюремний одяг і до кінця життя постійно їв за царським столом.
uk.R: Єгояхину більше не треба було носити тюремного одягу. До кінця свого життя він їв за царським столом.

decisions.choice: the same words as 2 Kings 25:29
decisions.reason: The verse is the same as 2 Kings 25:29 with "continually" and "before him" in the other order, and the wording follows it.

decisions.choice: he changed: Jehoiachin changed his clothes
decisions.reason: The subject is most likely Jehoiachin, who put off his prison clothes; it could also be the king, who had them changed. Either way his time as a prisoner was over.

decisions.choice: ate bread before him: ate at the king's table
decisions.reason: To eat at the king's table was a mark of honor and of provision for life, as David gave Jonathan's son Mephibosheth (2 Samuel 9:7, 13).

decisions.choice: Jehoiachin; at the king's table (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:29, Balanced and Readable name Jehoiachin and say "at the king's table" for "before him".

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 25:29
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same as 2 Kings 25:29, and each level copies its Hindi.

decisions.choice: ел хлеб перед ним постоянно
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew as 2 Kings 25:29 (m1) but for the order of "before him" and "continually"; Literal follows the order of this verse.

records.literal_gloss: And his allowance, an allowance continual, was given to him from with [the] king of Babylon, [a] matter of [a] day in its day, until [the] day of his death, all [the] days of his life.

en.L: And his allowance, a regular allowance, was given to him by the king of Babylon, a day's portion each day, until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
en.B: And the king of Babylon gave him a regular allowance, a portion for each day, until the day he died, all the days of his life.
en.R: Every day the king of Babylon gave him what he needed for that day. This went on as long as he lived, until the day he died.

es.L: Y su ración, una ración continua, le fue dada de parte del rey de Babilonia, la porción de cada día en su día, hasta el día de su muerte, todos los días de su vida.
es.B: Y el rey de Babilonia le dio una ración fija, una porción para cada día, hasta el día de su muerte, todos los días de su vida.
es.R: Cada día el rey de Babilonia le daba lo que necesitaba para ese día. Así fue mientras vivió, hasta el día de su muerte.

fr.L: Et son entretien, un entretien continuel, lui fut donné de la part du roi de Babylone, la ration de chaque jour en son jour, jusqu’au jour de sa mort, tous les jours de sa vie.
fr.B: Et le roi de Babylone lui assura un entretien régulier, une portion pour chaque jour, jusqu’au jour de sa mort, tous les jours de sa vie.
fr.R: Chaque jour, le roi de Babylone lui donnait ce dont il avait besoin pour la journée. Cela a duré tant qu’il a vécu, jusqu’au jour de sa mort.

sw.L: Na posho lake, posho la daima, alipewa na mfalme wa Babeli, kiasi cha siku kwa siku yake, mpaka siku ya kufa kwake, siku zote za maisha yake.
sw.B: Naye mfalme wa Babeli akampa posho la daima, sehemu ya kila siku, mpaka siku alipokufa, siku zote za maisha yake.
sw.R: Kila siku mfalme wa Babeli alimpa mahitaji yake ya siku hiyo. Hivyo ndivyo ilivyokuwa maisha yake yote, mpaka siku alipokufa.

vi.L: Phần lương của ông, một phần lương thường xuyên, được vua Ba-by-lôn cấp cho ông, mỗi ngày một phần, cho đến ngày ông chết, mọi ngày trong đời ông.
vi.B: Vua Ba-by-lôn cấp cho ông một phần lương thường xuyên, mỗi ngày một phần, cho đến ngày ông qua đời, suốt đời ông.
vi.R: Mỗi ngày vua Ba-by-lôn cấp cho ông những gì ông cần dùng trong ngày ấy. Việc ấy kéo dài suốt cuộc đời ông, cho đến ngày ông qua đời.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 생활비, 곧 끊이지 않는 생활비가 바빌론 왕에게서 그에게 주어졌는데, 날마다 그날의 몫이 그가 죽는 날까지 그의 평생 동안 [주어졌다].
ko.B: 그리고 바빌론 왕은 그에게 정기적으로 생활비를 주었는데, 그가 죽는 날까지 평생 동안 날마다 그날의 몫을 주었다.
ko.R: 바빌론 왕은 그가 사는 동안 날마다 그날 필요한 것을 그에게 주었다. 그가 죽는 날까지 그렇게 했다.

pt.L: E a sua provisão, uma provisão contínua, lhe foi dada pelo rei da Babilônia, a porção de cada dia no seu dia, até o dia da sua morte, todos os dias da sua vida.
pt.B: E o rei da Babilônia lhe dava uma provisão regular, uma porção para cada dia, até o dia em que morreu, todos os dias da sua vida.
pt.R: Todos os dias o rei da Babilônia lhe dava o que ele precisava para aquele dia. Isso continuou enquanto ele viveu, até o dia em que morreu.

am.L: ቀለቡም፣ የዘወትር ቀለብ፣ እስከሚሞትበት ቀን ድረስ በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ የዕለት ድርሻው በየዕለቱ ከባቢሎን ንጉሥ ዘንድ ይሰጠው ነበር።
am.B: የባቢሎን ንጉሥም እስከሞተበት ቀን ድረስ በሕይወቱ ዘመን ሁሉ የዘወትር ቀለብ፣ የዕለት ድርሻውን በየዕለቱ ይሰጠው ነበር።
am.R: የባቢሎን ንጉሥ በየቀኑ ለዚያ ቀን የሚያስፈልገውን ይሰጠው ነበር። ይህም በሕይወት እስከ ኖረበት፣ እስከሞተበት ቀን ድረስ ቀጠለ።

hi.L: और उसका भत्ता, एक नियमित भत्ता, बाबुल के राजा की ओर से उसे दिया जाता था, हर दिन के लिए उस दिन का भाग, उसकी मृत्यु के दिन तक, उसके जीवन के सब दिन।
hi.B: और बाबुल का राजा उसे एक नियमित भत्ता, हर दिन के लिए एक भाग, उसके मरने के दिन तक, उसके जीवन भर देता रहा।
hi.R: बाबुल का राजा उसे हर दिन उस दिन की ज़रूरत की चीज़ें देता रहा। यह उसके जीवन भर, उसके मरने के दिन तक चलता रहा।

ru.L: И содержание его, постоянное содержание, давалось ему от царя Вавилона, на каждый день — дневная доля, до дня его смерти, во все дни его жизни.
ru.B: И царь Вавилона давал ему постоянное содержание, долю на каждый день, до дня его смерти, во все дни его жизни.
ru.R: Каждый день царь Вавилона давал ему всё, что было нужно на этот день. Так было всю его жизнь, до самого дня его смерти.

uk.L: А його утримання, постійне утримання, давав йому цар Вавилону, денну частку щодня, до дня його смерті, усі дні його життя.
uk.B: А цар Вавилону давав йому постійне утримання, частку на кожен день, до дня його смерті, усі дні його життя.
uk.R: Щодня цар Вавилону давав йому те, чого він потребував на той день. Так тривало, поки він жив, аж до дня його смерті.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:30 with "until the day of his death"
decisions.reason: The verse follows 2 Kings 25:30, but names "the king of Babylon" where Kings has "the king", and adds "until the day of his death". The same words closed the account of Zedekiah (verse 11): both kings of Judah ended their days in Babylon, one blind in prison, the other honored at the king's table.

decisions.choice: a day's portion each day: a daily share
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of a daily quota or ration (Exodus 5:13; 16:4). The king provided for him day by day.

decisions.choice: the allowance: royal rations
decisions.reason: Clay tablets from Nebuchadrezzar's palace in Babylon record rations of oil given to "Ya'ukin, king of the land of Yahud" and to his sons, which shows that Jehoiachin was already supplied by the court years earlier.

decisions.choice: an open ending: the book closes with David's heir alive in exile
decisions.reason: The book of Jeremiah does not end with the burning of the temple but with the king of David's line freed and honored in Babylon. Jeremiah had told the exiles to settle there and wait, for the LORD would bring them back after seventy years (29:4-14). The writer does not say what Jehoiachin's release means, but the ending leaves room for the hope the book has held out (23:5-6; 33:14-17).

decisions.choice: the king of Babylon gave him (Balanced, Readable); what he needed for that day (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Kings 25:30, Balanced and Readable make the king the subject instead of the passive "was given". Readable explains the allowance and puts "as long as he lived" before "until the day he died" so that the two phrases do not repeat each other word for word.

decisions.choice: hasta el día de su muerte
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's Hebrew adds "until the day of his death" to the wording of 2 Kings 25:30.

decisions.choice: 2 Kings 25:30 with "የባቢሎን ንጉሥ" for "ንጉሡ" and "እስከሚሞትበት ቀን ድረስ" (until the day of his death) added.
decisions.reason: Jeremiah's Hebrew adds both; the rest is copied ("ቀለብ", "የዕለት ድርሻው በየዕለቱ").

decisions.choice: the wording of 2 Kings 25:30, with "बाबुल के राजा" and "उसकी मृत्यु के दिन तक"
alternatives: "राजा"; without the day of his death
decisions.reason: The verse copies the Hindi of 2 Kings 25:30 at each level, adding what Jeremiah's Hebrew adds: "of Babylon" after "the king" and "until the day of his death".

decisions.choice: царь Вавилона; до дня его смерти
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 25:30 with "the king of Babylon" and "until the day of his death" (m1); otherwise its wording at each level.
